This is a model’s form order, not a predicted finishing order. A shared-race link is evidence, not proof. Different trips, conditions, fitness and weights can reverse results. Separate form groups cannot be ranked reliably against each other.

The method, the data, and the missing pieces +

Connections you can check

Two horses are linked when both appear in the same historical race. A chain can pass through a rival that is not running today. Each step shows who finished ahead, the margin between them, and the race.

What the rating does

We fit a regularised, weighted least-squares rating to pairwise beaten margins across the available network. A horse’s rating minus its rival’s rating aims to explain their margin. All usable results contribute; a selected chain alone does not determine the verdict.

Recency and distance

Race weights halve every 45 days. A distance similarity factor reduces the influence of runs far from today’s trip. Pair margins are capped at 8 lengths to limit outliers; comparisons within one race are normalised to reduce field-size effects. A ridge penalty of 0.15 pulls sparse evidence toward neutral. Display score = 50 + 45 × tanh(raw rating / 4).

Read uncertainty with the score

This is an uncalibrated form model, not a betting price. Separate network groups cannot be reliably compared. Sparse runners may be under- or overrated. Higher evidence means more connected runs, not a measured chance of winning. Results are not transitive: A beating B and B beating C does not guarantee A beats C.

Scenario assumptions

Ground matching keeps full weight for matching runs; other ground gets 1 − your matching-ground strength (default 0.3). At 0% strength, choosing ground has no rating effect. Prefer Flemington halves other-track evidence. Weight correction uses your lengths/kg × (historical weight − scenario weight) for each current runner before fitting. Missing historical weights receive no correction. The draw slider assigns up to 2L at the favoured end and the opposite penalty at the other end of the eligible field’s barrier range. Manual extra lengths are added after fitting. The focused chart range makes small changes visible without changing scores. Impact messages compare actual ratings; small effects are not amplified in the model.

Photos and silks

Silks are the TABtouch race-day sprite for each listed runner. Historical photos may show older silks. Photo credits link to the originating article. Where a verified photo is unavailable, the card shows the runner’s silks and an explicit placeholder. You can add your own photo for the current tab session.

Historical form + race-day updates

Fields and recent starts come from TABtouch’s published form for all nine races. Only the recent starts shown there are used; trials are excluded. Historical race winners are included as bridge nodes. Full historical fields are not available, so some genuine connections will be missing.

Recent form remains a fixed, dated snapshot. The live module separately checks reported track condition, runner changes and official results. Emergencies stay excluded until a final field is confirmed. Automatic ground preference reweights past starts; it never invents ground suitability. Optional same-day gate learning uses only earlier official results on comparable going and course, is shrunk towards neutral and capped at 0.35L. Pace and actual racing lanes are not available; jockey wins do not automatically add ratings.
